terms.gloss: for a change, for variety’s sake
terms.comment: Traupman’s phrase, of classical words; not found as a phrase in Lewis & Short or the Latinitas loci collections, so Traupman is the only evidence.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 95, checked against the searchable text and the page images of the book.: p. 289.
